usefulness.rationale: The dossier body is completely empty; the only content is identity anchors and one retained source (a 2026 Rappler conference article) that was never extracted. No claims exist, so there is nothing to assess for overclaims, and a reader learns nothing beyond the three anchor phrases — insufficient to know who Ressa is, what she did, or prepare for a meeting. The empty dossier also gives no accounting of what is unknown, so remainingQuestions is minimal.
